title: Python for scientific work
purpose: Write readable programs, check their outputs and retain reproducible notebooks for scientific calculations.
primary_reading: MIT 6.0001 Introduction to Computer Science and Programming in Python

blocks.deliverable: Write unit conversion functions with boundary checks.
Implement a sequence generator and explain every line.
Load a small data file and summarize it without manual edits.
Run a practical midcourse test; detect a deliberately inserted bug.
Compare finite differences at several step sizes.
Compare a numerical trajectory against a known solution.
Deliver code, instructions, dependencies and a short live explanation.

project: Create a notebook that simulates a simple motion model and compares it with an analytic solution.
completion: finish the final project and practical or oral assessment, repair issues found during review, and retain the full data or code and a short account of remaining limitations.
